breakdown.description: The opposing horizontal tractions are reinterpreted as boundary-normal loads on the horizontal edges
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly reinterpreted a horizontal traction (σ_xx=±1000 Pa) as a normal (vertical) traction on the horizontal top and bottom edges. The ground truth removed this flawed reinterpretation, indicating the load should remain horizontal as originally specified. The agent, however, followed the incorrect instruction, stating: 'The top edge (y=0.5) is subjected to an inward normal traction of 1000 Pa, meaning the traction vector is (0, -1000) Pa on the top edge.' This is a vertical load, not the intended horizontal one.
